notes: The tuition fee of 178 EUR/year shown is the general public rate on the Parcoursup page; a separate Campus France Maroc page states non-EU (extra-communautaire) students in Licence pay differentiated fees of 2902 EUR/year, but that page is not this programme's own page. The intake deadline given is a recurring deadline without year (13 May). Applying through Études en France for a Moroccan Bac holder is a manual check note.
